title: CRM Analytics Academy — channel trailer
note: Flat, no camera moves: the whole trailer is one CRM Analytics app (kit/platform.jsx). Scenes switch like dashboard tabs (`transition: tab`). Text and music only, plus your camera clips: `clip` names a file in workspace/01-camera/trailer/ (any of .mov .mp4 .m4v); until it exists the scene is a placeholder saying what to record (see trailer-clips.md). A clip longer than its `bars` stretches the scene to whole bars, and the music ducks under it.

props.pill: Someone has to build this. Why not you?

props.title: Hi, I'm Swarnil
props.say: Hi, I'm Swarnil. On this channel I teach CRM Analytics end to end, the way it's used at work, on real data.
notes: 6 to 8 seconds, one take, smile, then talk
Eye level, you on the left third (the name card sits bottom left)
Soft light from the front, tidy background
Clip-on or USB mic close to you, no music in the recording

props.title: Subscribe, then build with me
props.say: Subscribe, open lesson one, and build it with me. See you inside.
notes: 4 to 6 seconds, same setup as clip 01
Point toward the right of the frame at 'subscribe' (the button appears there)
End on a smile and hold one second before you stop recording
